description:
We're hiring several Senior Account Executives to build our presence across territories in North America. In this role, you'll own new business development within your assigned territory. Your territory will include organizations in some of our priority industries: Transportation, Utilities & Telecommunications, Architecture, Engineering & Construction (AEC), and Education & Local Government. Organizations in these sectors run some of the most complex data environments anywhere - asset and infrastructure inventories, network and facility data, CAD and BIM models, sensor and IoT feeds, regulatory reporting, and decades of legacy systems that have to talk to each other. This is a consultative, high-outbound role: you'll build your own territory and account plan, multi-thread GIS, IT, and business-unit stakeholders in parallel, run Safe's structured sales process end to end, and grow a first departmental win into a broader platform relationship. Closed accounts hand off cleanly to Account Management and Customer Success so you can keep hunting.

About The Team

Safe builds FME, an All-Data, Any-AI enterprise integration platform trusted by 25,000+ customers in 125+ countries to bring their data to life. We're profitable and growing, with a loyal installed base and a lot of room still to grow. Our Sales team helps organizations around the world discover what FME can do for them, working region by region and market by market.

Each of these roles covers a dedicated geographic territory, giving you full ownership of the accounts and opportunities in your region. Industries like transportation, utilities, telecommunications, AEC, and education and local government are priority sectors within those territories and are important to Safe's next stage of growth. You'll work alongside Sales Engineering, Product, Marketing, and our partner network, and report to the Director of Sales. Our Sales team is a supportive, collaborative environment that values customer success, continuous learning, and transparency — and because these territories are new, you'll have genuine influence over how Safe approaches your territory.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Senior Account Executive, you will:

  • Run the full sales cycle — prospecting through close — for new-logo opportunities across accounts in your assigned territory.

  • Build your territory and account plan largely from scratch, including ICP mapping, account prioritization, and a named target list.

  • Open new departments and buying centers inside accounts where Safe already has a foothold, growing a single-team win into a platform relationship.

  • Build relationships with GIS, IT, and business-unit stakeholders in parallel, across both technical and commercial sides of an account.

  • Understand customer challenges and align FME solutions to address data integration, automation, and workflow needs in complex, data-intensive environments.

  • Collaborate with Sales Engineers to deliver technical demonstrations, solution designs, and proofs of concept.

  • Run Safe's structured sales process end to end (Create → Qualify → Develop → Prove → Negotiate → Contract), applying MEDDPICC qualification at every stage.

  • Maintain accurate CRM data and sales forecasting in HubSpot, and participate in a weekly forecast and pipeline cadence.

  • Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the Account Manager and Customer Success team with a full account brief.

  • Leverage Safe Software's partner network — including resellers, system integrators, and OEMs — to support opportunity development and customer success.

  • Provide customer and market insights to Product and Marketing to inform roadmap and go-to-market strategy.

  • Represent Safe Software at industry events and conferences to build relationships and grow pipeline.


Qualifications, Skills, and Competencies

Safers come from a variety of backgrounds with a diversity in skills and knowledge. That said, we find that those who are most successful in this role have experience with the following areas.

What We're Looking For:

  • 6+ years of enterprise software or SaaS sales experience, with a track record of closing $250K+ ACV deals.

  • Experience selling to technical buyers in regulated, asset-intensive, or public-sector industries — transportation, utilities, telecommunications, AEC, education, local government, or similar.

  • Demonstrated success building pipeline in a new or underpenetrated territory, without relying on inbound leads.

  • Experience building technical, IT, and business-unit relationships in parallel within a single account.

  • A track record of turning a departmental foothold into a broader platform deal (land-and-expand).

  • MEDDPICC or equivalent qualification discipline, including the judgment to qualify out early when a deal isn't the right fit.

  • A track record of accurate forecasting and consistent quota attainment.

  • Comfortable working in a high-outbound, goal-driven environment with measurable targets.

  • Skilled in consultative and value-based selling approaches.

  • An excellent communicator with a collaborative, customer-first mindset.

  • Proficient with CRM tools like Hubspot and virtual sales tools.

  • Willingness to travel up to 25–30% for customer meetings and industry events.

Desired skills / Bonus points:

  • Background selling data integration, GIS, ETL, or automation software.

  • Familiarity with spatial data, sensor/IoT data, or the data environments common to transportation agencies, utilities, telecom providers, AEC firms, or local government.

About Safe Software

Safe Software transforms organizations with FME, the only All-Data Any-AI Enterprise Integration Platform connecting all your data, anywhere, at any velocity.

With over 30 years of expertise and 25,000+ enterprise customers across 125+ countries, we simplify your data journey, wherever it leads.

Founded in 1993, Safe is headquartered in Surrey, BC with over 300 team members and counting. We’re always looking for talented individuals with diverse backgrounds who are determined to learn and grow. Are you ready to join the team?


Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

Safe Software is an equal opportunity employer and we truly believe that innovation and strength begin with diversity and inclusion.

We welcome all candidates regardless of race, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, ability, disability, national or ethnic origin, political belief, religion, or family status.

Should you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please contact hr_dept@safe.com.

Notice Regarding Use of Automated Tools in Hiring

At Safe Software, we use automated tools to help us process applications and identify qualified candidates. These tools may assist in screening resumes and summarizing interview content based on the information you provide. This helps our team review applications efficiently while ensuring every candidate is considered based on the requirements of the role.

Please be assured that the final hiring decision is always made by a member of our team. For more information on how we protect your privacy, please see our policy. If you have questions about this process, please contact us at hr_dept@safe.com.
